checks.name: (a) short write: rc = 4 bytes actually appended (not 10)

notes: xv6 logging makes recorded block updates crash-atomic; it does not undo a failed function. Our rule: whatever bytes were written are recorded in the same transaction (short-write semantics), and zero-progress failures are not recorded. We do NOT claim all-or-nothing append on disk-full.
